label: Kurse
research: Eversports Manager / Mindbody Business / Bsport: a class has a roster; staff check people in on the phone by tapping names (a counter 'x of y checked in', 'check in all'); waitlist moves up automatically, cancelling asks; the class schedule is the main view of a course/series with past dates collapsed; a course page shows capacity, waitlist, next date at the top. Teachable/Kajabi course pages: overview with key numbers, then the curriculum (here: dates), students as a list. Empty states offer the first step ('Create class', 'Add schedule'). Taken: course page per patterns.md §8 with Stats (Belegt, Warteliste, Nächster Termin, Anwesenheit), dates as the main content (next first, earlier collapsed), participants below, properties edited in place on the right; attendance as a phone-first tap-to-mark list that saves each tap, with 'Alle da' and ‹ › to the neighbouring dates; the next step as primary (Anwesenheit for today's date, else Termine anlegen / Person hinzufügen).

pages.phone: RecordLayout: course details (aside) below participants and dates.
uxNotes: 'Abmelden' (cancel a participant, moves the waiting list up) has no confirm.
Date sheets use a plain SubmitButton (justify-self-end), not <SaveBar> like other create sheets.
Series times use native <input type=time> (browser locale), against the DateInput rule.
Weekday checkboxes have only an sr-only legend: no visible label in the series sheet.
Participants are not a <DataTable> (hand-built list rows), so no bulk actions, no cards on phones, no paging.
The edit form (Kursdaten) sits in the aside, the lists in the main column (same as rentals objects, unlike HR/projects).
'Leitung' is free text, not linked to HR employees or shift staff.
Dates appear here but there is no calendar view of a course; the shared /calendar links back here, not to the session.

pages.phone: Attendance rows are large tap targets (min-h-10, size-5 checkboxes).
uxNotes: A small record (date + note) is a full page instead of a sheet on the course (docs: small records → ?edit=<id> drawer).
Two plain 'save' buttons in two forms (attendance, date) instead of <SaveBar>; no unsaved-changes guard.
'Termin löschen' is an outline button inside the edit card, no confirm, not a red ⋯ item.
